blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The Mandaue City Government is seeking access to inspect a privately owned lot beside Opao Elementary School, following reports of dengue fever among pupils, including 15 individuals who tested positive. Mayor Thadeo Jovito “Jonkie” Ouano said that some residents had pointed to the property as a possible mosquito breeding site. Two five-year-old kindergarten students from Barangays Opao and Umapad reportedly died from dengue. The city and Ouano have extended financial assistance.
